correctness.rationale: The Prüfer bijection makes a uniform Cayley tree an iid uniform word W of length m=n−2 on n labels. A fixed vertex degree equals N_v+1, where N_v is its word occupancy, and total leaves L=Σ_j 1{N_j=0}. The distinguished-own term in E[Lz^{N_v}] is ((n−1)/n)^m; every other label contributes ((n−2+z)/n)^m, giving the exact mixed generating function. Differentiating at z=1 and subtracting E[(N_v)_r] E L yields (m)_r n^(−r) a^(m−r)[(n−1)−na^r]. The bracket is exactly zero for r=1, strictly positive for 2≤r≤n−2, and tends to r−1 for fixed r, yielding the (r−1)/e limit. Conditional occupancy on N_v=k gives the stated strict one-step valley. Independent complete Prüfer enumeration through n=7, including all 16,807 length-five words, verified the generating-function factorial moment consequences, degree-order-one cancellation, and all available higher positive factorial covariances. The all-n result is proved by multinomial factorial moments.
